meta.source: Claude Design project 'Operator Console design system', Directions page, Turn 5 frame 5b (4b subtle); motion and density carried from its guideline pages

tokens.name: chassis-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the chassis gradient: the outer frame of a screen or product.

tokens.name: chassis-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the chassis gradient; also the flat floor color behind panels.

tokens.name: panel-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of a raised panel (alarm card, side panel).

tokens.name: panel-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of a raised panel.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed display well: dials, traces, logs, legends. The darkest ground; the only ground where `text-3` meets 4.5:1.

tokens.name: well-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of an unlit lamp tile (bottom stop is `well`).

tokens.name: seam
tokens.usage: Edges, bezels, dividers and the 1px outline around every panel and key.

tokens.name: dial-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled track of dials and bars.

tokens.name: hub
tokens.usage: Needle hub fill on dials.

tokens.name: text-1
tokens.usage: Primary text and readouts on every ground (12:1 or better).

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions, unlit lamp values. 6.8:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Labels, ticks, metadata. Source value: 4.7:1 on `well`, but 3.7–4.1:1 on panels and chassis, below 4.5:1 for small text. Use it on `well` for small labels; on panels only for 9px caps labels paired with a stronger value, never alone for meaning.

tokens.name: text-bright
tokens.usage: Text on the primary key (`signal` fill), 4.8:1.

tokens.name: key-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of a secondary key.

tokens.name: key-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of a secondary key; `text-1` reads 12:1 on it.

tokens.name: signal-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the primary key.

tokens.name: signal-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the primary key.

tokens.name: signal-edge
tokens.usage: Bottom lip (2px) under the primary key.

tokens.name: stop-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the Stop control only.

tokens.name: stop-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the Stop control.

tokens.name: stop-edge
tokens.usage: Bottom lip under the Stop control.

tokens.name: on-stop
tokens.usage: Text and stop glyph on the Stop control, 5.0:1.

tokens.name: warning-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of a lit warning lamp (master warning, failed andon tile).

tokens.name: warning-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of a lit warning lamp.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a lit warning lamp, 5.0:1.

tokens.name: caution-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of a lit caution lamp (spend, blocked, priority chip).

tokens.name: caution-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of a lit caution lamp.

tokens.name: on-caution
tokens.usage: Text on a lit caution lamp, 8.7:1.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: Run state: running. Filled circle glyph. Also the signal color for live values and the safe band of dials. 5.1:1 on panels.

tokens.name: waiting
tokens.usage: Run state: waiting (and queued). Outlined circle glyph. 5.5:1 on panels.

tokens.name: blocked
tokens.usage: Run state: blocked, needs the operator's answer. Filled triangle glyph. Also the caution band of dials.

tokens.name: approval
tokens.usage: Run state: in review, waiting for approval in GitHub. Filled diamond glyph.

tokens.name: failed
tokens.usage: Run state: failed. Filled square glyph. Also the hard-limit band and limit lines.

tokens.name: merged
tokens.usage: Run state: merged. Ring-with-dot glyph. Deliberately neutral: done work goes quiet.

tokens.name: stopped
tokens.usage: Run state: stopped. Outlined square glyph. Source value: 3.4:1 on `well`, under 3:1 on panels. Always pair the glyph with a `text-2` label.

styles.name: readout-xl
styles.usage: Hero readout: elapsed time on run detail.

styles.name: readout-dial
styles.usage: Value inside a dial. Color follows the zone.

styles.name: readout-lamp
styles.usage: Value on an andon lamp tile; 600 when lit.

styles.name: readout-trace
styles.usage: Current value on a trace header.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Identifiers: issue numbers, labels, branches, models, costs, log lines.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Alarm headline: the agent's question, the PR's reason.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sessions store UTC but the booking API returns venue-local times.

styles.name: key
styles.usage: Key labels, sentence case. Secondary keys use weight 500.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Engraved small-caps labels on lamps, dials and wells. Write them in capitals.

styles.name: legend
styles.usage: Status legend and state words beside a glyph, lowercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between legend items.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label-to-value gap inside a lamp; well inner padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between andon lamp tiles and the bezel padding around them.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap inside alarm cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between keys; well padding; lamp tile horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: row-dense
tokens.usage: Row height: desktop tables, annunciator.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Default row and key height.

tokens.name: hit
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on the pager.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags and chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Lamp tiles, small wells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Keys.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Display wells, master warning.

tokens.name: radius-bezel
tokens.usage: Andon bezel.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Raised panels and alarm cards.

tokens.name: radius-chassis
tokens.usage: Chassis frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The Stop control only (half its 36px height).

tokens.name: shadow-chassis
tokens.usage: Chassis frame: one hairline top highlight, seam outline, drop.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Raised panel.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: Recessed display well.

tokens.name: shadow-bezel
tokens.usage: Bezel around the andon lamp row.

tokens.name: shadow-lamp
tokens.usage: Unlit lamp tile.

tokens.name: shadow-lamp-warning
tokens.usage: Lit warning lamp tile: glow plus lens highlight.

tokens.name: shadow-lamp-caution
tokens.usage: Lit caution lamp tile.

tokens.name: shadow-master
tokens.usage: Lit master warning: bezel ring, glow, lens.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: Secondary key.

tokens.name: shadow-key-primary
tokens.usage: Primary key.

tokens.name: shadow-key-stop
tokens.usage: Stop control: guard ring plus lip.
